items.promptEn:
A: I have a terrible sore throat.
B: That's too bad. You ________ see a doctor.
choices: must not
won't
had better
would
can't

items.promptEn: 밑줄 친 can을 may로 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 문장을 고르세요.
choices: Can you imagine the world without the Internet?
He can repair almost everything with the right tools.
He can dance various styles, from jazz to hip-hop.
Can I have some more juice on the table?
How fast can you run 100 meters?
